notes.title: The FPS Fixing Update
notes.content:
Hello, guys! 

One of the[b] biggest struggles[/b] of Explosive Candy World was getting the [b]physics engine to run at the intended speed.[/b]

When I started developing this game, I had a monitor that only went up to [b]75FPS.[/b] So I programmed all of the game's speed without taking into account bigger framerates (too bad on my part haha). 

Soon after release, I bought a monitor that could go up to 144FPS, and was shocked to see that this [b]game ran at lightning speed![/b] It didn't run at the intended speed!

That was very frustrating, so I tried for some time to get this fixed, but with no success.

[b]But now, it IS fixed![/b] I applied a plugin that[b] limits the game's FPS, so it can't go over 75FPS.[/b]

This is a little problematic for people who are used to high framerate monitors, but unfortunately that is the only solution possible.

Because right now everyone running the game at over 75FPS is getting an accelerated experience, like Sonic the Hedgehog, which is not the pace intended for Explosive Candy World.

Hopefully everyone enjoys this update and can [b]experience the game again at the correct speed![/b]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Our next game: Release Date Confirmed for the metroidvania Dimensional Animals!
notes.content:
[h1]Release date SET![/h1]

Hello, guys! Marcos here. I'm the main developer behind Explosive Candy World.

I'm here to announce our next release: DIMENSIONAL ANIMALS!

This metroidvania adventure filled with action, exploration and retro goodness will release on [b]June 5th, 2024![/b]

We are [b]just a few weeks away[/b] from its release. Hope you're excited!

The game will release at a fair price and I'll also bring in a very juicy release discount! So hopefully I can count on you to get your copy right as the game releases, on June 5th!

[h1]But I want to play NOW![/h1]

Don't worry, because while you wait for the full release of the game, I have launched an [b]updated version of the demo[/b] allowing for a bit more of exploration!

You can download it now on Dimensional Animal's steam page.

Please also tell your friends about it and ask them to play the demo too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344060/Dimensional_Animals/

Thanks for hearing the news! I'm on full steam here to make the best experience possible!

See you soon!

[i]Special thanks to all members of the Dimensional Animals development team:
- Hugo Andrade on pixel art
- Malu Colusso on music
- Jonas Siebeneichler on sound effects[/i]

notes.title: An issue in 144hz framerate partially fixed
notes.content:
Hey guys! Thanks for supporting my working and playing Explosive Candy World. Hope you are having fun with the game!

So, an issue came to my attention regarding monitors with higher refresh rates. I didn't know this was happening because at the time I had a 75hz monitor, and recently upgraded to a 144hz one which made me realize the issue.

If your monitor has 144 refresh rate the game will start with an absurd speed, and will gradually slow down to the correct speed. I honestly don't know why this happens, and since I only got to know this a whole year after the game's release (and had to find out myself) I suspect this isn't a big issue for the players who experience it.

So if you're having trouble with the game's speed, try the following:
- Run the game and wait for about 15 seconds so the speed normalizes
- Or simply change your monitor refresh rate settings. I tested it at 84hz and it ran pretty smoothly!

TLDR
If your computer has a higher refresh rate than 75hz it is possible you'll experience some acceleration in the game. You can simply wait it out because it seems the game will get to the correct speed by itself after a few seconds, or set a lower refresh rate to your monitor (about 84 is great)

What I did actually fix with this update was a game freezing bug that rarely happened after acquiring the gold cane. The screen would simply not advance to the next level. It is now fixed!

Thanks!
